scope: Frozen-candidate diagnostic, NOT Gate-F or confirmatory certification. No training or seed selection. Independently generated finite-time trajectories, not equilibrium samples.
sample_budget_reason: Fixed diagnostic budget informed by measured CPU rate and tests/results/reference_precision_plan/summary.json: n128 pointwise binomial worst half-width about .090, not a physical tolerance or proof of power. Four initials limit across-initial inference. No automatic top-up.

analysis.look: One complete-batch descriptive analysis; no partial outcome-driven changes. Failed generation is a failure, never dropped/replaced silently.
analysis.reference_groups: R1 first128 noise paths, R2 next128; G128 per model, initial and condition. Same initial across conditions, disjoint noise; three trained seeds separately reported.
analysis.primary_diagnostics: Per-initial magnetization means/variances, spatial dot/connected correlations, temporal dot/connected correlations and increments; compare G-R1 with R1-R2 at prefixes800,4000,16000. Save every trajectory.
analysis.uncertainty: 2000 whole-trajectory bootstrap replicates, fixed seed860000000; initial-wise results first, across-initial summaries cluster by initial with same initial resampling shared across temperatures. Shared R1/R2 resamples across models. Descriptive intervals, no uncalibrated simultaneous pass claims.
analysis.events: negative_endpoint and crossed_zero descriptive only. No committed-switch claim until basin/dwell calibration; no imported arbitrary .6 threshold certification.
analysis.decision: No automatic GO or model promotion; separate reference uncertainty, numerical discretization and model mismatch. Integrator control only covers initial0, not all initial families. No large-L or long-horizon extrapolation certification.
